messages.author: a4e8478057bed621
messages.subject: Proportion mediated in mediation analysis
parts:
Hello!

I'm trying to do a mediation analysis and would like to compute the proportion mediated as follows:

# indirect effects
indirect_C1   := td*ct
# total effects
total_C1   := cd + td*ct
# proportion mediated
prop.mediated_C1   := indirect_C1 / total_C1

However, I receive the following error:
Error : The following error occured when compiling and adapting the model using rjags: Error in rjags::jags.model(model, data = dataenv, inits = inits, n.chains = length(runjags.object$end.state), : Error in node def[9,1,1] Invalid parent values

This is the relevant part of the model:
108 | def[1,1,1] <- beta[1,6,1] * beta[2,1,1] ... 112 | def[5,1,1] <- beta[2,6,1] + beta[1,6,1] * beta[2,1,1] ... 116 | def[9,1,1] <- def[1,1,1]/def[5,1,1]

Alas, I'm not very familiar with JAGS. But I suspect it has to do with the possibility of division by zero. If this is correct, one approach would be to use ifelse in JAGS (see e.g. here). Is there a way to achieve this within blavaan? I thought about overriding the JAGS syntax with mcmcextra somehow, but I couldn't figure it out.

Any help is greatly appreciated!

All the best,
Paul

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Proportion mediated in mediation analysis
parts:
Paul

Might I ask why you are using JAGS instead of the default target Stan? Also, do you get an error with Stan?

You can also extract the posteriors and do those calculations outside of blavaan, will lead to the same

posts <- as.matrix(blavInspect(fit, "mcmc"))

This will get you the posterior draws, and then can do the claculations with the respective columns
